text:
maria (partnerships): Quick kickoff: aim is staging-ready listings for AWS/GCP/Azure by EOW. Must-haves: publisher access, legal redlines, SKU/tier map, image IDs (AMI/container), screenshots, trial entitlements, metering headers, and a minimal 'getting started' snippet for the store page. Who picks what? :spiral_calendar:

lina (product): I'll own SKU taxonomy + store copy outline. Proposal: RWX-<product>-<tier> as canonical SKU, with a separate cloud-variant mapping file. Question: do we show region pricing on storefront or keep price global and map region availability in manifest?

dev (eng): I can produce the image index and deploy snippets. Plan: create s3://internal/marketplace/indexes/images-index-3205551234.json that lists per-sku artifacts per-cloud and a tiny helm/az cli snippet. Example snippet in manifest text (not a file upload):

```
{"sku":"RWX-llm-pro","aws":{"amis":["ami-0f1a2b3c4d5e"]},"gcp":{"images":["gcr.io/redwood/runner@sha256:ffff..."]},"azure":{"images":["registry.azurecr.io/redwood/runner:sha-2026"]}}
```

dev (eng): Also will request PublisherAdmin role on staging publisher so I can upload artifacts — please grant to dev CI account.

sam (legal): I'll run EULA + privacy redline. Need confirmation on telemetry: product must confirm we do NOT forward raw prompts to marketplace partners. Also note: Azure requires storefront translations FR/DE/JA and an EU data residency blurb for certain customers.

ben (ops): Metering needs: header X-RW-TENANT (tenant id), X-RW-METER-SIGN (signed ping optional), fields: sku, units, region, usage_type (inference|embeddings). Example meter ping body: {"sku":"RWX-llm-pro","units":5000,"region":"eu-west-1"}. We'll need the SDK to set X-RW-TENANT or fallback to org-id.

marie (marketing): I'll draft the short one-liner + three bullets and assemble 3 screenshots (dashboard, invite flow, billing). Need a staging tenant/org name so screenshots are safe for partners. Can someone create org "Redwood Staging - MARKETPLACE" in staging?

marketplace-bot: staging publisher provisioned -> publisher=p-123321, console=https://staging-pub.redwood.example/login, grant link=https://staging-pub.redwood.example/publishers/p-123321/roles :white_check_mark:

lina (product): On trial length: suggest default 14 days with a marketing promo SKU "trial-2026" for special partner promos. Also: recommend bundling a dev tier (limited tokens) plus pro tier (unlimited with quota).

sam (legal): 14 days OK. I'll add cloud-specific refund windows in the redline and a short privacy clause confirming no raw prompt forwarding. Need product to sign off on telemetry retention period (30 vs 90 days).

maria (partnerships): Owners: lina -> SKU + store copy, dev -> artifacts + uploader snippets, sam -> EULA/redline + localizations, ben -> metering & billing mapping, marie -> marketing assets/screenshots. I'll schedule a 25m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to close blockers. Please drop links to your drafts in this thread. Thanks everyone :rocket:
